name: taskbar-hero-clone
description: Taskbar Hero RPG/MMORPG — pixel-art idle RPG by ArkansasIo
author: ArkansasIo

scripts.check: node --check main.js && node --check preload.js && node --check preload-inventory.js && node --check --input-type=module < src/game.js
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:assets && npm run android:apk:debug && npm run android:apk:release
scripts.android:apk:debug: npm run android:assets && cd android && gradle :app:assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:release: npm run android:assets && cd android && gradle :app:assembleRelease
